messages:
maria: quick sync — planning a smoke + microbench sweep for the new fused-kernel path (paged+flash). Looking for volunteers to run harnesses, collect NVTX traces, and verify no tail-latency regressions. Would like runs today/tomorrow. Ops: can we schedule a canary slot? :calendar:

devon: I can run the microbench harness. Which branch & commit? Is there a test matrix (seq len, batch sizes)?

maria: branch is rtm/fused-paged-exp (PR #4892). Matrix: seq=[64,128,512,1024], batch=[1,4,8], kv-cache warm/cold. Target GPUs: A100-80GB and H100-80GB. Collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, CUDA mem snapshots, and NVTX. Upload traces to s3://redwood-perf/exp/1767000000/

sasha: I'll grab NVTX + perf counters on H100. Do you want the full nvprof or just lightweight nvtx ranges? :eyes:

maria: NVTX ranges preferred + CUPTI kernel times. Keep nvprof off unless we need deep traces (space/time). Use the harness flag --nvtx and --cupti-sampling=1000

devon: command I'll run:
```
GLOG_v=1 LD_PRELOAD=/opt/instr/libinstr.so python infra/microbench/run.py \
  --model ./checkpoints/fused-paged.pt --seq 512 --batch 4 --steps 200 \
  --nvtx --cupti-sampling=1000 --output s3://redwood-perf/exp/1767000000/devon
```

maria: perfect. also include --kv-warmup=1 and --cache-mode=[warm|cold] runs. Name logs like devon_h100_seq512_b4_warm

rj: heads up — there's a known memory accounting mismatch on the branch that makes memsnap inaccurate for small batches. Add `--mem-override=accurate` to enable new accounting (it's in PR but not default).

devon: good catch, will add it. any QA checklist? regressions thresholds?

maria: regression thresholds: throughput drop >6% vs baseline and p99 increase >10% flagged. If flagged, ping #eng-runtime with summary and attach traces. Also add nvprof callstacks if p99 jumps.

ops-bot: Canary slot reserved: 1767001800 -> 1767005400 on pool:canary-rtm (A100). Job owner: maria. :white_check_mark:

lee: I'll review PR #4892 in the next hour. Quick ask: can we include a short self-check script that compares baseline numbers? Even just a JSON with metrics.

maria: yes — added `infra/microbench/compare_baseline.py` in the PR. It emits combined_metrics.json with baseline + current. Use it after runs and paste summary to the thread.

sasha: uploading initial NVTX template to s3://redwood-perf/templates/nvtx_template.json

devon: runs started on h100 now, will update with first results in ~25m. :construction:

maria: thanks all — if you get significant p99 regressions hold canary and I'll revert the routing rule. otherwise we aim to promote to canary-rtm by EOD. :rocket:

qa-bot: quick reminder: please tag results with `experiment_id=1767000000` for downstream dashboards.

maria: noted. ping me here once you've uploaded the summary. thx!
